rationale: The apparent price gap is purely currency: contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated 1 Jan–31 Mar 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH is exactly USD 231.00/EACH as invoiced — normalisation, not a defect (clause 7, clause 11.1). Goods receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 EACH received against 40 ordered and invoiced (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% is exactly $693.00 (clause 5). No defects; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
